attempts.text:
**The window starts in a long persistent stretch.** Columns 0 to 17 are spine, carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 17% of calls. The model names 18 to 99.8% of genes there, mean 90%, and is most hesitant at column 10, `yjjQ`, named 18%, 0.92 bits.

**A short fork follows at `lgoR` and `lgoT`**, columns 18 to 19, in a region of plasticity in 55 to 56% of calls, named 86 to 89%. Then column 20, `tsr`, is spine again, carried by 91%, in a region of plasticity in 55% of calls, named 87%, 0.55 bits.

**The rest of the window is fork and variable columns**, 21 to 79, in a region of plasticity in 34 to 70% of calls, named 68 to 92%, mean 81%. A second branch of 11 families runs through columns 21 to 31, carried by 28 to 33%, all shell: `hpaR` to the 4-hydroxyphenylacetate 3-monooxygenase, [[homoprotocatechuate degradation]]. Smaller branches carry `mrr` to `hsdM`, the KilA-N protein to the LexA regulator, and `yfdP` to `yfdR`.

**The `fim` genes spread across the middle.** `fimH` to `fimB`, columns 47 to 55, variable and fork, carried by 58 to 74%, [[type 1 fimbria assembly]]. The model hesitates most at column 42, `uxuR`, 1.32 bits, in a region of plasticity in 36% of calls.

**The window ends sparsely.** Columns 57 to 71 are variable, carried by 4 to 64%, and the last columns fall to 15 to 24%. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 1.20 against 0.36 bits, and names fewer genes, 71% against 94%.

label: ytjA
facts:
WINDOW: the ytjA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ytjA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,743 to 3,822 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ytjA once); 43,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 83% of genes, 0.74 bits on average (perplexity 2.2 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 20,432 calls, named 96%, 0.20 bits; shell 21,446 calls, named 76%, 1.13 bits; cloud 1,162 calls, named 14%, 3.06 bits. Outside an RGP 23,487 calls, named 94%, 0.36 bits; inside an RGP 19,553 calls, named 71%, 1.20 bits. Columns: 19 spine, 32 fork, 29 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.20 against 0.36 bits) and names fewer genes (71% against 94%); 19,553 of the 43,040 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 42 (uxuR) 1.32 bits, RGP 36%; column 60 ("DUF957 domain-containing protein") 1.26 bits, RGP 57%; column 41 ("hypothetical protein") 1.22 bits, RGP 36%. The 44 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 80%, 0.88 bits on average; the other 36 columns: named 88%, 0.57 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 20 (spine), RGP 55%; the least: columns 0-17 (spine), RGP 0-17%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-17 (18 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0-17%. Genes: ytjA "DUF1328 domain-containing protein", osmY, prfC, yjjG "pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase", rimI, holD, rsmC, yjjZ "DUF1435 family protein", fhuF, bglJ, yjjQ "helix-turn-helix domain-containing…", yjjP "threonine/serine ThrE exporter fami…", yjjB "threonine/serine exporter", dnaT "DnaT-like ssDNA-binding domain-cont…", dnaC, yjjA "DUF2501 domain-containing protein Y…", opgB, lgoD "L-galactonate oxidoreductase". named 18-99.8% (mean 90%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 10 (yjjQ), named 18%, 0.92 bits.
2. columns 18-19 (2 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 55-56%. named 86-89% (mean 87%), fewest named at column 18, named 86%; most hesitant at column 19, 0.94 bits.
   18 variable: lgoR S 86%
   19 fork: lgoT S 73%; also "cation:proton antiporter" S 14%
3. column 20 spine: share 91%, all P, RGP 55%. Genes: tsr. named 87%; 0.55 bits.
4. columns 21-79 (59 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 34-70%. named 68-92% (mean 81%), fewest named at column 79, named 68%; most hesitant at column 42, 1.32 bits.
